subject: maths
question: In what time will Rs. 3,20,000 amount to Rs. 4,05,000 if compounded at 12.5% per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.3,20,000

Amount = Rs.4,05,000

Rate = 12.5%

**Formula used:**

Amount = P × (1 + R%)T

Where, P = principal ; T = time ; R = rate

**Calculation:**

Amount = P × (1 + R%)T

⇒ 405000 = 320000 × {1 + (12.5/100)}T

⇒ 81 = 64 × {1 + (12.5/100)}T

⇒ 81/64 = {112.5/100}T

⇒ {9/8}T = (9/8)²

So, time (T) = 2 years

**∴ The correct answer is 2 years.**
